checks.detail: 52 of 52 checks: every program compiled with gcc 13.3 (-std=c17 -Wall -Wextra -Werror) or parsed by Python 3.13, and every terminal session on the page replayed with its output compared line by line.

Type sizes and limits, uint8_t wrap-around, sanitizer report for INT_MAX + 1, little-endian byte order, Python integer sizes (28 and 160 bytes on Python 3.13) and UTF-8 bytes of ₹, € and क all observed on the test machine (x86-64 Linux, gcc 13.3, Python 3.13). Theorem 2.1 proved in full in the text.
Sanitizer line number corrected to 8 (the file-name comment is line 1). The checker now reads a program's output and error messages as one stream, in the order a terminal shows them.
